#compdef coop
# Coop Zsh integration.
# Generate: coop completion zsh > ~/.config/coop/completion.zsh
# Source this file after compinit in ~/.zshrc.
_coop() {
  local -a cands
  cands=(${(f)"$(coop __complete "${(@)words[2,$CURRENT]}" 2>/dev/null)"})
  compadd -- $cands
}
compdef _coop coop
alias coop='nocorrect coop'
